Saved field fidelity, concurrent editing, immutable snapshots, inspection without changing draft/current data or execution, restore advancement, same-attempt retry after intervening changes, two simultaneous mutation cases and restart survival are expressly requested in behaviour.md:25-40 and integration.md:9. Corresponding history/race criteria are tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:500-581 and protocols tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:461-479. Editor face, line numbers, colouring, named controls, keyboard navigation, focus and narrow-screen use are explicit in ui.md:3-9; visual anchors permit conventional/native simple styling and assess the requested readable interface, without mandating branding or multiple themes.

Adversarial source reasoning: a browser-storage-only saved library cannot satisfy tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29's independent clean-context server readback; an in-memory server can pass that basic gate but fails the separately requested process-restart observations (tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:429-433). These are test-design observations, not executed weak-app results. A conforming server-rendered library with different labels/API fields, a single theme, non-unit revision increments, a modal history viewer and a static restored last-good picture is expressly accommodated by tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:27, policy.md:5, tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:13,17,19,463-470 and tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:43-49; no added requirement was found for those alternatives.
